policy.meaning: Operational source coverage, not a claim of complete product or vulnerability coverage.

product_families: IOS/IOS XE, NX-OS and infrastructure products explicitly listed in advisories
cisco.history_scope: Current RSS and curated advisories; advertised CSAF archive index reviewed but backfill disabled pending supported document access
known_gaps: Feed window is bounded; arbitrary historical advisories are not exhaustively enumerated.
Some release-note requests return HTTP 403.
Archive index is readable, but five sampled exact document URLs returned 403 to the anonymous collector; hosted access is not established.

product_families: ArubaOS and networking products encoded in the CSAF index
aruba.history_scope: Current CSAF index, benchmark search up to 200 documents; historical normalization resumes at 16 documents per scheduled pass
known_gaps: Index cap and exact inspected count are recorded; hardware/configuration qualifications remain source-defined.
Historical queue progress is reported separately; the listed index does not establish every product or earlier disclosure.

arista.history_scope: Current RSS and curated advisories; paginated public historical listing at eight documents per scheduled pass
known_gaps: Only reviewed layouts are supported; affected platforms and deployment scope require consulting the source.
Historical enumeration follows advertised pages; unsupported document layouts remain explicit gaps.

product_families: GlobalProtect and other explicitly named product rows
paloalto.history_scope: Current RSS and curated JSON/HTML; public historical GET-form listing at eight documents per scheduled pass
known_gaps: Shared multi-CVE tables remain shared unless a scoped exception is explicitly encoded.
Component presence alone does not establish exploitable exposure.
CSV export is page-limited; historical enumeration follows the reviewed public form, with no authenticated advisories included.

product_families: Selected Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved CNA rows with platform/configuration context
juniper.history_scope: Current RSS discovery and bounded verified Juniper CNA follow-ups; pinned SSR/Apstra documents and selected Junos records; not a historical portfolio census
known_gaps: Application shells can prevent article extraction.
RSS discovery is not resolved product applicability; PDF adapters are deliberately narrow.

product_families: Products listed by the active advisory index
Explicit Quantum Force, CloudGuard Network and Quantum Spark customer statements in a curated vendor blog
checkpoint.history_scope: Active product index plus two reviewed public SK articles
known_gaps: Active index is not a complete archive.
Details-in-SK rows remain unknown; IPS signatures do not establish affectedness.
Cloud requests to some support pages receive interactive bot-verification pages. These are classified as access gaps, never solved or treated as advisory content.
The curated regreSSHion blog does not replace detailed SK platform/version exceptions or Terrapin scope.

fortinet.history_scope: Current RSS and curated release notes; filtered historical PSIRT listing at eight documents per scheduled pass
known_gaps: Some structured exports contain discovery metadata without product assessments.
Fixed release statements do not establish affected ranges in older firmware.
Historical listing uses the publisher default infrastructure product selection, not the entire Fortinet portfolio; observed filters are reported.
Empty CSAF exports can use the reviewed public HTML investigation-list fallback; other unsupported layouts remain gaps.

hpe.history_scope: Four pinned bulletins for Cray, NonStop, iLO and ProLiant; no general HPE advisory discovery feed
known_gaps: This profile is a curated sample, not HPE-wide coverage.
Reported firmware dates are not independently verified public availability.
